## About
Hello, I'm Jestin Ross, and Hoss Roofing is a local DFW company, located in McKinney. We're a true general contractor, so there's no need for multiple contractors coming into your home. Just one you can trust.
Our mission is to provide honest roofing principles while never taking advantage of the customer. We'd rather educate you so you can make the best decision for your home, and we treat every home as if it were our own.
Good work takes a bit more time. You get what you pay for, and the job is not done until it is done right. We're rated 5 on Google from 174 reviews. Our work speaks for itself, just ask your neighbors.

## Services
- New Roofing Systems: Complete tear offs and new roofs, installed to our own detailed specifications.
- Gutters: Gutter system installs to go with your roof or on their own.
- Paint / Trim: Interior and exterior paint and trim. One customer had us do brick, trim and paint on the outside of his home.
- Fences / Stain: Fence work and staining around your property.
- Interior / Exterior Remodeling: From raised ceilings and new doors to a rebuilt fireplace with stacked stone and a slate hearth.
- Bathrooms / Kitchens: Kitchen and bathroom remodels, handled by the same crew from start to finish.
- Drone Inspections: We fly the roof and you watch the live video onsite, so you can see the damage for yourself instead of trusting a stranger's opinion.

## FAQ
Q: Is the inspection free?
A: Yes. Give us a call to schedule your free inspection.

Q: Someone called me about storm damage saying they're Hoss Roofing. Is that you?
A: Probably not. We do not cold call or solicit storm damage work, and we only contact customers from our official number. If you're ever unsure, call us directly to verify.

Q: Do you pull permits?
A: Yes. We pull all required permits on every job, so you know we don't cut corners.

Q: Can you help after a storm?
A: Yes. We handle storm restoration and walk you through the entire process.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Yes. Every job is custom tailored to the client, so we work by appointment only.
